description: This file defines the ScriptList class and ScriptListIterator class for managing and exposing list-like data structures in TorchScript, including Python bindings and iteration support.

classes.name: ScriptList
classes.description: A wrapper around c10::List that can be exposed in Python with list-like API, supporting reference semantics across Python and TorchScript boundaries.

classes.name: ScriptListIterator
classes.description: An iterator over ScriptList elements, supporting iteration in Python.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the list.

methods.name: iter
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list elements.

methods.name: toBool
methods.description: Interprets the list as a boolean value.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the item at a specified index.

methods.name: setItem
methods.description: Sets the item at a specified index.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a value exists in the list.

methods.name: delItem
methods.description: Deletes the item at a specified index.

methods.name: len
methods.description: Returns the size of the list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of a value.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a value to the list.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the list with an iterable.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns an element at a given index or the last element.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a value before a specified index.

methods.name: wrap_index
methods.description: Wraps an index to be within valid range for list access.
